manualPreflight: The operator acknowledges this exact candidate SHA only after completing the separately reviewed private preflight; this manifest is not evidence that those operations ran.
Confirm production still runs the v0.0.8 baseline SHA at schema version 11, the PostgreSQL container/volume and encrypted-object storage are unchanged, and the independent deletion ledger is healthy.

Prepare an encrypted policy-compliant metadata and schema backup privately with at most 7 days retention; exclude share token hashes, sessions, challenges and retry records, environment_key_wraps and environment_file_challenges. Never roll back the independent deletion ledger.
Gate external API changes for this API domain and confirm the old API process has stopped before the candidate starts; keep the cookie-less /auth/session check and container health available.

Keep maintenance in place until schema version 12, the five environment publication tables, the upload_cancellations publication kind, deletion-ledger health, API health and the matching web/relay release are verified. Require stale clients to reload.

After migrations commit, recovery is forward-only: keep traffic gated and the old API stopped on failure. Do not automatically restore the old API image; database disaster recovery requires the separately reviewed restore-safe procedure.
